turns.customer: Beacon 500 vs Glowworm 300 headlamp: which is brighter, and which lasts longer on a charge or set of batteries?
turns.reply:
The Beacon 500 is brighter, with 500 lumens compared to the Glowworm 300's 300 lumens. 

When it comes to battery life, the Glowworm 300 lasts longer, offering a burn time of 1,800 minutes (30 hours) versus the Beacon 500's 1,200 minutes (20 hours).
